died.name: Nostradamus
died.last_words: Tomorrow, at sunrise, I shall no longer be here.

died.name: George Beesley
died.desc: English Roman Catholic priest and martyr
died.last_words: Absit mihi gloriari nisi in Cruce Domini Nostri Jesu Christi [Far from me to glory except in the cross of Jesus Christ]. Good people, I beseech God to send all felicity.

died.name: Hortense Mancini
died.desc: Duchesse de Mazarin, niece of Cardinal Mazarin and mistress of Charles II of England

died.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
died.last_words: Throw up the window that I may see once more the magnificent scene of nature.

died.name: Georgiana Drew
died.desc: American stage actress, mother of Lionel, Ethel and John Barrymore
died.last_words: Oh, my poor kids. What will ever become of them?

died.name: Ed Delahanty
died.cause: The 35-year-old American baseball player for the Phillies died after being removed from a train due to drunken horseplay, falling off International Bridge above Niagara Falls. Sam Kingston, a local night watchman, was the last to see him alive, reportedly scuffling with him. Kingston's account of the incident was spotty and inconsistent; it is unclear whether Delahanty was intentionally pushed, accidentally fell, or decided to jump.

died.name: Peter Kürten
died.desc: German serial killer known as "The Vampire of Düsseldorf"
died.last_words: After my head is chopped off, will I still be able to hear, at least for a moment, the sound of my own blood gushing from the stump of my neck? That would be the pleasure to end all pleasures.

died.name: Amelia Earhart
died.cause: reporting to her headquarters in her last known radio transmission shortly before her disappearance
died.last_words: We are running on line north and south.

died.name: Mary Reeser
died.cause: The 67-year-old woman was found by police in her St. Petersburg, Florida, home almost totally cremated where she sat, while her apartment was relatively damage-free. Some speculate that she spontaneously combusted.

died.name: Ernest Hemingway
died.cause: before committing suicide with a shotgun

died.name: Fireball Roberts
died.cause: inside his burning car after 24 May 1964 wreck during the World 600 at Charlotte Motor Speedway. Roberts survived for six weeks before dying of his injuries
died.last_words: My God, Ned, help me! I'm on fire!

died.name: Vladimir Nabokov
died.cause: he had a keen interest in butterflies
died.last_words: A certain butterfly is already on the wing.

died.name: James Stewart
died.last_words: I'm going to be with Gloria now.

born.name: Thomas Cranmer
born.cause: alluding to Acts 7:56 KJV prior to execution by burning
born.last_words: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit... I see the heavens open and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

born.name: Christoph Willibald Gluck
born.desc: composer of Italian and French opera
born.cause: when asked whether a tenor or a bass should sing the role of Christ in The Last Judgement
born.last_words: If you wait a little, I shall be able to tell you from personal experience.

born.name: Clarence W. Barron
born.desc: American newsman and de facto manager of The Wall Street Journal

born.name: James Averell
born.cause: to the cattlemen who lynched him along with his wife, Ellen Watson

born.name: Geoffrey Saxton White
born.cause: before being killed by a shell on the deck of HMS E14 in the Dardanelles during World War I
born.last_words: We are in the hands of God.

born.name: Iven Carl Kincheloe Jr.
born.cause: final radio transmission prior to failed ejection from Lockheed F-104A
born.last_words: Edwards, Mayday seven seven two-bailing out.
